import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter the data for the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_df = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of the top 10 dog breeds, colored by the district (KreisLang)
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_df, y='Rasse1Text', hue='KreisLang', order=top_breeds, palette='tab10')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich by District')

plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.legend(title='District', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter the data for the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_df = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of the top 10 dog breeds, colored by the district (KreisLang)
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_df, y='Rasse1Text', hue='KreisLang', order=top_breeds, palette='tab10')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich by District')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.legend(title='District', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
